what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Senegal in Brazil: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 261 Senegalese asylum seekers in Brazil, 0.7% of all asylum seekers from Senegal.
Refugees from Senegal, a separate group, live mostly in France, Gambia, Canada and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Casamance territory in Senegal in periods from 1997 to 2011, with the MFDC.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2015 to 2022, come after the last of those conflict years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 9 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 8633, at the end of 2017, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Brazil.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Brazil only.
